title: Correct expression for N
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be N = F₁ / √(2ZemU) or its equivalent algebraic form.

title: Correct expression for F/P
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be F/P = √(2m/(ZeU)) or its equivalent algebraic form.

title: Valid suggestions for increasing F/P
description: Essential: The response for part (3) must list three distinct, physically valid methods based on the derived expression, such as increasing ion mass, decreasing ion charge, or decreasing voltage U.

title: Application of work-energy theorem
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the accelerating voltage to the ion's final kinetic energy using ZeU = (1/2)mv².

title: Momentum transfer reasoning
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second and third laws to relate thrust to the rate of change of momentum of the ion beam (F = N m v).

title: Power derivation from force and velocity
description: Important: The solution must correctly derive the power as P = (1/2) F v, recognizing the work done on ions starting from rest.

title: Algebraic manipulation and simplification
description: Optional: The solution shows clear, logical algebraic steps to combine equations and solve for the required quantities N and F/P.

title: Sign or definition error in thrust
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student confuses the direction of force or incorrectly equates thrust to electric force without Newton's third law.

title: Incorrect power formula
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the power is incorrectly calculated as P = F v (instead of (1/2)F v) for ions accelerated from rest.

title: Unit or proportionality error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the final expressions have incorrect dimensional dependence (e.g., F/P proportional to 1/√U instead of √(1/U)).
